Technology Commons is an open-source teaching project. Different parts of the project use different licences.

## Website code and executable materials

Original website code and executable materials are licensed under the [GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 only](https://www.gnu.org/licenses/agpl-3.0.html) (`AGPL-3.0-only`). This includes JavaScript, CSS, executable Quarto documents, scripts, tests, and build tooling.

## Educational content

Original educational text, articles, lessons, diagrams, and explanatory figures are licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) (`CC-BY-SA-4.0`).

When reusing this material, give appropriate credit, link to the licence and source, indicate whether changes were made, and share adaptations under CC BY-SA 4.0 or a compatible licence.

Suggested credit:

> Based on material from **Technology Commons** by Andrew Andrade and contributors. Source: <https://github.com/backgammonsimplified/commons>. Licensed under **CC BY-SA 4.0**. Changes were made.

## Data and third-party materials

Data releases use the licence stated with each release. Third-party code, fonts, screenshots, quotations, and other materials retain their original licences. See the repository's [third-party notices](https://github.com/backgammonsimplified/commons/blob/master/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for details.

## Identity and branding

The software and content licences do not grant rights to represent a fork or adaptation as an official Technology Commons site or as the work of Andrew Andrade. Adaptations should use their own identity when necessary and should not imply endorsement.

## Full terms

The repository [licensing summary](https://github.com/backgammonsimplified/commons/blob/master/LICENSE.md) defines the scope. The unmodified licence texts are stored in the repository's `LICENSES` directory.
